name: entertainment-mode-lights
goal: Entertainment mode turns on the main-floor lights and keeps them on while the mode is on. When the mode ends, each room goes back to its normal logic.

userStories.title: Room on-files turn the lights on
userStories.description: Add a light turn_on after the Adaptive Lighting pause in the foyer, kitchen and family room on-files, and create a dining room on-file.
acceptanceCriteria: Each room turns on its listed lights at 100%, after the Adaptive Lighting pause
A new dining_room_entertainment_mode_on with the same trigger and condition as the other rooms

userStories.title: Hold while on, hand back on off
userStories.description: Add a mode-off condition and a mode on-to-off trigger to seven off automations. The Away paths stay as they are.
acceptanceCriteria: All seven automations have the condition and the trigger
The foyer still turns its lights off for Away while the mode is on
No direct turn_off is added, and *_to_away is unchanged

userStories.title: Tests
userStories.description: Add structural tests to tests/test_entertainment_mode.py, plus a sabotage check.
acceptanceCriteria: The tests cover the on-files, the hold, the hand-back and the Away bypass, and that *_to_away is untouched
The sabotage check makes a test fail

userStories.title: Docs
userStories.description: Update the room table in the entertainment README, and add notes to the room LEARNINGS.md files and the kitchen README.
acceptanceCriteria: The README lists the lights, the hold and the hand-back
The room docs mention the hold briefly
